stage: FIRST RULE FREEZE before dispatch and artifact/log access; source hashes bound in a separate receipt

independence.freshness: Actual fork_turns=none dispatch evidence required; runtime history_mode is not proof.
independence.no_intervention: No method root/revision, role paths, checklist, source hints or reading reminders from root/QA before first submission seal. Business may discover project instructions itself.
independence.seal: QA does not inspect live artifacts/runtime logs before root seals first submission. Read only sealed copies and authorized fixed log prefixes. Unprompted pre-seal author changes must be timed; not called immutable since readiness.
independence.revisions: Later rereads/repairs get separate seals/results and cannot replace the first trial. Encrypted task text is not decrypted; prompt copy, root dispatch and visible logs have separate provenance.

scope.task: Read-only product handoff and minimum future acceptance conditions for leaving and returning to voice interview practice during answering or after feedback.
forbidden: persisting private fulltext or reconstructable page caches, including temp
copying raw logs or analysis/reasoning/account metadata
scope.mechanism_tests: Repair mechanism QA is separate and never counts as business reading/application.

required_sources.task_evidence: Current relevant implementation and latest related product/QA records sufficient to trace answer, recording, transcript, feedback and context lifecycles; exact paths are located independently after seal, not invented here.
required_sources.notes: Full current AGENTS includes original nonempty lines171/173. Inspect direct task-closeout filenames for newer uncovered records. Two examples remain unapplied examples. Two proposals are protected, not counted as method bodies.

checks.pass: Frozen ordinary prompt, actual fresh dispatch and no pre-seal hints corroborated.
checks.fail: Inherited method context or external reading hints contaminate first trial.
checks.insufficient: Dispatch or nonintervention cannot be corroborated; keep provenance limits.

checks.pass: Separate source binding after repair QA and before dispatch captures root/branch/HEAD plus dirty/untracked byte hashes, method origin/HEAD/blob/worktree, protected proposals. Recheck drift at QA.
checks.fail: Wrong source or HEAD-only version asserted for uncommitted bytes.
checks.insufficient: No fixed source binding or only author self-report.

checks.pass: Every required body's actual visible business tool outputs cover frozen bytes completely. Compare content in memory; track source/hash and all page/byte intervals and continuity. No gaps, false ranges, unbound versions or truncation.
checks.fail: Required body omitted or a known omission claimed complete.
checks.insufficient: Missing outputs/pages, truncation or ambiguous reassembly. read_bytes, hashes, checker exit0, summary, line count or final page alone cannot pass. Outer functions truncation also counts.

checks.pass: Visible tools trace project entry to permitted local locator and ten fixed bodies without root/QA hints. Wrong/denied source stays blocked without alternate-copy scan/network/bypass.
checks.fail: Undisclosed external path hints, unauthorized search/network, wrong fixed revision passed off as correct.
checks.insufficient: Only locator hash or discovery self-report.

checks.pass: Accurate source/section-specific summaries, task applicability and limits for original role/memory, continuity and method; QA checks meaning. PM-MEM-0001 supports role-memory boundary, not invented product priorities.
checks.insufficient: Only paths/hashes, all-read claim, copied text, IDs or generic summary.

checks.pass: At least a relevant fixed-method/checklist principle is accurately applied in the actual artifact and independently located. M01 task/state relation, M06 source/claim layers, M07 real return branches may fit; M08 only for relevant state/interaction evidence. Other methods need actual rationale. Plans separate.
checks.fail: Force all M01-M08, treat examples as project facts, or claim method migration without business reading.
checks.insufficient: IDs/quotes/plans, resemblance or author self-check without source-to-artifact reasoning.

checks.pass: Independently trace each material preservation/recovery/loss claim to current source and records. Distinguish answer/transcript/audio/feedback/question context as relevant, same-document return, practice switch, reload/reopen and pending/error/late-response cases. State actual storage/lifetime/reset limits and proposal/current behavior separately.
checks.fail: Material preservation promise or loss denial contradicts current source, or an omitted relevant branch misleads handoff.
checks.insufficient: Missing dependencies or runtime-only assertions without execution evidence.

checks.pass: Conditions have precondition/action/observable expected state/failure signal, source/version context and responsible handoff; cover task-relevant return, pending/error and identity branches. Clearly unexecuted and minimal.
checks.fail: Conditions imply already tested, silently change standards or cannot distinguish loss/state mismatch.
checks.insufficient: Slogans, vague preserve-everything or only headings.

checks.pass: Different execution context actually reads sealed artifact and current supporting source and records concrete findings/reasons/limits. Author self-check, independent static QA, mechanism tests and runtime remain separate.
checks.fail: QA label substitutes actual review, self-check called independent, or static evidence upgraded to runtime/full-product pass.
checks.insufficient: Different identity with no review evidence.

checks.pass: Visible actions remain authorized, source/protected endpoint bytes remain bound, old FAIL/partial/first submissions/voice insufficient/13pass2fail/smoke/full-product not_met persist. Endpoint hashes are not continuous monitoring.
checks.fail: Prohibited action, private body/cache persistence, overwritten failure or unsupported adoption/growth.
checks.insufficient: Unobserved scope cannot be excluded; bound claim to visible evidence.

decision_policy.natural_complete: Requires all required full bodies, ten fixed method files, correct source binding and unprompted discovery. Good artifact quality and QA代读 do not fill reading gaps.
decision_policy.whole_trial: Report freshness, coverage, readback and selective actual application separately. Required missing bodies yield FAIL/partial or insufficient as supported, never full pass.
decision_policy.business_document: Independent static quality verdict; material defect means needs_revision. No forced finding or irrelevant method requirement.
decision_policy.runtime: not_tested by authorization; no full product acceptance. Historical failures and DQ-01 document-only closure do not establish current engineering/runtime repair.
decision_policy.revision: Preserve first finding, source/artifact hashes and results; later author repair and narrow recheck are separate.

runtime_log_policy.allowed: Only root-provided business and QA runtime paths and fixed prefix bytes/lines/hashes. Parse visible function/tool inputs/outputs and commentary/final only.
runtime_log_policy.provenance: Minimum root-authorized execution-source fields may support independent contexts, never certify all reads.
runtime_log_policy.report_only: Short summaries, hashes, nonreconstructable page/byte ranges, call/output identifiers, artifact positions and findings. No raw logs/fulltext/page caches.

qa_preparation.original_qa_pack: ROLE, MEMORY, MEMORY_SCHEMA and approved-preferences consumed; QA-MEM-0001 adapted to brief product handoff, no textbook-length requirement.
qa_preparation.method: All ten fixed documents consumed in current QA output only; never credited to business.
qa_preparation.records: New entry/locator/paging guides, original product pack/preferences, two archive/two closeout, prior natural-read README/protocol/final receipt and first/revision QA reports read. No old raw runtime log accessed.
qa_preparation.preparation_truncation: A combined preparation response truncated; affected guide remainder and product-role/preferences reread in bounded complete calls. This is QA preparation only.
